proof_body:
by
  intro A B _ _ _ _ _
  have h : (Finset.univ.filter (fun f : A → B => Function.Injective f)).card = (Fintype.card B).descFactorial (Fintype.card A) := by
    rw [← Fintype.card_subtype, ← Fintype.card_embedding_eq]
    exact Fintype.card_congr (Equiv.subtypeInjectiveEquivEmbedding A B)
  rw [h, Fintype.card_fun]
  push_cast
  rfl
target_source: ∀ (A B : Type*) [Fintype A] [Fintype B] [DecidableEq A] [DecidableEq B] [Nonempty B], ((Finset.univ.filter (fun f : A → B => Function.Injective f)).card : ℝ) / Fintype.card (A → B) = ((Fintype.card B).descFactorial (Fintype.card A) : ℝ) / (Fintype.card B : ℝ) ^ Fintype.card A
